questions.text: If POST /api/appointments does not refuse Inactive doctors or patients today, can implement add that check to the service layer? The design says the booking path (EP-2) stays unchanged.

rubric_items.reason: All seven design components (CO-1 to CO-7) appear with at least one threat. EP-1 and the action routes are covered through T-9 and T-11.
Most threats fit the change: the UI-only disabled state, the reason kept out of the URL, and patient data on the detail page. T-8 is a correctness bug labelled as tampering.
Mitigations cite existing controls or name new ones for implement. T-1 and T-5 present unconfirmed server checks as existing controls.
T-6 is honestly marked assumed. T-1 depends on the same unconfirmed server check but is listed as known, and the server-side 300-character check is never confirmed.
Readable and consistent, and the summary matches the front matter. Threats are grouped by component, not ordered by risk.
